parameters.name: IsHistory
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the historical tasks.

Default value: 0. Valid values:

- 0: returns the current task.

- 1: returns the historical tasks.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Specify a value greater than 10. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description:
The region ID of the instance.

> If you set the Region parameter to **all**, all tasks created within your Alibaba Cloud account are queried. In this case, you must set the **taskType** parameter to **all**.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description:
The type of the task. Valid values:

- rds\_apsaradb\_ha: master-replica switchover

- rds\_apsaradb\_transfer: instance migration

- rds\_apsaradb\_upgrade: minor version update
